## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) — it becomes the squashed commit subject, and the required `conventional PR title` check gates it.
- [ ] Changeset added for any user-facing change (`.changeset/*.md` — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)), or the `no-changelog` label applied for CI / refactor / tests / docs.
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change (the `tests` check enforces a 96% coverage gate).
- [ ] Docs / README updated where user-facing behaviour or config changed.
- [ ] `uv run pytest` and `uv run pre-commit run -a` pass locally.
